title: Daily Banking Specialist with German language
full_description:
Our department WB Daily Banking & Channels Support is responsible for 1st line support to our clients on a cross-product Commercial Banking interactive channel. You’ll be working in an international team to support our clients worldwide with technical and functional support on this new channel, products and payments related questions.
Something for you? Be a part of an international changing environment where „Every day is a new day“
How are you contributing to ING?
You will support our corporate clients for DB services in our portfolio
You will be responsible for financial data investigation and analysis (operational topics, payment related questions)
You will provide direct support to our corporate clients in banking operational workflow topics
You will play an essential role in continuously improving our client satisfaction
You will assist clients in detecting technical and functional issues with channel related services and use your extensive experience and knowledge to diagnose, prioritize, advise and resolve technical and functional problems
You will identify and bring forward suggestions for continuous improvement, provide input for larger projects based on own experience and best practices
You will maintain contact with clients and/or stakeholders and keep them informed about the progress of their request
You will set-up clients on the new channel and related services and coordinate the end-to-end administrative process
You will be responsible for data investigation and analysis to complete clients requests
Are you also someone who…
• has exceptional organizational, planning and time management skills
• coordinates activities and comes up with solutions
• is client-oriented, patient and attentive with clear and positive communication skills
• has English and German language knowledge
• is highly collaborative, self-driven with focus on delivery
• has attention to detail and able to recognize important information, research and make connections
• is flexible and comfortable in a fast changing environment
... Then you are our new Operations Specialist!
Wage (gross)1547 EUR/month
*By legal requirement we are providing the information about the basic wage component (minimum salary) for the advertised position. Based on your experience/profile, the final financial conditions will be the subject to discuss and negotiate at the personal interview, however, not less than above mentioned minimum salary component.
